boundary: Manifest verification and later recount remain separate validated reads. The accepted claim is per-read input validation and parse/digest byte identity, not an atomic corpus or a hostile-host filesystem sandbox.

control_evidence.basis: Inspected all seven controls and verified their source and recorded execution-log hashes.

review: Independent review of audited-input boundary repair and scientific-output compatibility

reviewed_fix.compact_input: Parse and final digest consume the same validated bytes; no second path open for the final compact digest.
reviewed_fix.file_read: Regular-file admission, opened-descriptor identity matching, and post-read identity/length checks detect the tested replacement and observed mutation cases.
reviewed_fix.manifest_path: Canonical relative spelling, cross-platform drive/backslash rejection, component symlink rejection, and resolved containment.
reviewed_fix.native_trace: Trace parsing and its reported digest consume the same validated bytes.
